what: Rceattle — Multispecies Stock Assessment in R
title: Rceattle — Multispecies Stock Assessment in R
text: Rceattle: R package fitting climate-linked, single- multi-species age-structured stock assessment models testing via diagnostics, simulation, management strategy evaluation. Rceattle implements models R using Template Model Builder (TMB; Kristensen et al., 2015). Data can supplied via bundled Excel template constructed programmatically R list (see Building data object without Excel vignette). Capabilities include: Single-species (msmMode = 0) multispecies (msmMode > 0) configurations, one- two-sex population dynamics One multiple stocks can fit jointly. Multiple fisheries surveys flexible catchability selectivity parameterizations (logistic, double-logistic, non-parametric, time-varying, etc) Stock–recruitment options (Beverton–Holt, Ricker, mean-recruitment, environmentally-driven) Estimable growth (von Bertalanffy / Richards/ empirical weight--age) Environmental linkages priors recruitment, natural mortality, growth parameters Bioenergetics-based predation input temperature-specific consumption (multispecies mode) Forward projections alternative harvest control rules climate scenarios Closed-loop MSE, retrospective, jitter, simulation testing Tidy outputs via S3 methods (.data.frame, coef, logLik, vcov, residuals, plot) See browseVignettes("Rceattle") package website full documentation. Installation operational / management use, pin specific tagged release rather tracking main, e.g.: maintainer email DESCRIPTION (grant.adams@noaa.gov) preferred contact questions package; please open issue bug reports feature requests discussion publicly searchable. Getting started 1-species model Fit 2018 Gulf Alaska pollock model, inspect fit, plot : 3-species model Fit three single-species model jointly Bering Sea data: multispecies model, set msmMode = 1. See package vignettes (browseVignettes("Rceattle")) projections, alternative harvest control rules, MSE testing, model diagnostics, non-Excel data construction. deeper context, see onboarding document Wiki. model can updated following instructions . Examples Additional code function examples using data Bering Sea Gulf Alaska groundfish applications can found examples folder include: * Fitting single-species models * Fitting multi-species models * Estimating growth * Alternative HCRs MSE testing * Simulation * Model diagnostics References Adams, G.D., Holsman, K.K., Barbeaux, S.J., Dorn, M.W., Ianelli, J.N., Spies, ., Stewart, .J., Punt, .E., 2022. ensemble approach understand predation mortality groundfish Gulf Alaska. Fish. Res. 251, 106303. doi:10.1016/j.fishres.2022.106303 Holsman, K. K., Ianelli, J., Aydin, K., Punt, . E., & Moffitt, E. . (2016). comparison fisheries biological reference points estimated temperature-specific multi-species single-species climate-enhanced stock assessment models. Deep Sea Research Part II: Topical Studies Oceanography, 134, 360-378. Kristensen, K., Nielsen, ., Berg, C. W., Skaug, H., & Bell, B. (2015). TMB: automatic differentiation Laplace approximation. arXiv preprint arXiv:1509.00660. Wassermann, S. N., Adams, G. D., Haltuch, M. ., Kaplan, . C., Marshall, K. N., & Punt, . E. (2025). code: # Rceattle (pulls CRAN dependencies automatically) install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("grantdadams/Rceattle")  # Optional: TMBhelper provides richer optimization diagnostics. # Rceattle falls back to plain nlminb + sdreport if it's not installed. # remotes::install_github("kaskr/TMB_contrib_R/TMBhelper") remotes::install_github("grantdadams/Rceattle@4.3.0") library(Rceattle)  # Gulf of Alaska pollock data (1977-2018) data(GOApollock) plot_data(GOApollock)  # Fit the hindcast fit <- fit_mod(   data_list    = GOApollock,   estimateMode = 0,                              # 0 = fit hindcast + projection   fit_control  = fit_control(phase = TRUE)       # optimizer / sdreport / phasing knobs )  # S3 methods: the fit behaves like an R model object fit                       # compact print summary(fit)              # same compact summary coef(fit)                 # estimated fixed-effect parameters logLik(fit)               # logLik with df attribute (AIC works) AIC(fit) vcov(fit)                 # fixed-effect covariance from sdreport as.data.frame(fit)        # return data.frame of derived quantities  # Plot dispatcher: pick a panel with `what` plot(fit, what = "biomass") plot(fit, what = "ssb") plot(fit, what = "recruitment") plot(fit, what = "index")  # Residuals across data sources (long-format data frame) ix_resid   <- residuals(fit, source = "index")                  # response (log-scale) index residuals comp_resid <- residuals(fit, type = "pearson", source = "comp") # Pearson composition residuals all_resid  <- residuals(fit)                                    # response residuals, all data sources library(Rceattle)  # Bundled Eastern Bering Sea single-species data (1979-2017) data(BS2017SS) plot_data(BS2017SS)  # Fit the hindcast (single-species mode) fit <- fit_mod(   data_list    = BS2017SS,   msmMode      = 0,                              # 0 = single-species   estimateMode = 0,                              # 0 = fit hindcast + projection   fit_control  = fit_control(phase = TRUE)       # optimizer / sdreport / phasing knobs )  # S3 methods: the fit behaves like an R model object fit                       # compact print summary(fit)              # same compact summary coef(fit)                 # estimated fixed-effect parameters logLik(fit)               # logLik with df attribute (AIC works) AIC(fit) vcov(fit)                 # fixed-effect covariance from sdreport as.data.frame(fit)        # return data.frame of derived quantities  # Plot dispatcher: pick a panel with `what` plot(fit, what = "biomass") plot(fit, what = "ssb") plot(fit, what = "recruitment") plot(fit, what = "index")  # Residuals across data sources (long-format data frame) ix_resid   <- residuals(fit, source = "index")                  # response (log-scale) index residuals comp_resid <- residuals(fit, type = "pearson", source = "comp") # Pearson composition residuals all_resid  <- residuals(fit)                                    # response residuals, all data sources

M_prior Mean (natural-scale) lognormal prior M. M_prior_sd SD (log-scale) lognormal prior M. M1_indices Soft-deprecated. Vector column indices env_data (excluding Year) environmentally linked M1 M1_model %% c(4, 5). title: Specify the harvest control rule (HCR) used for Rceattle — build_hcr
text: HCR Harvest control rule use. Accepts integer equivalent string alias. Default = 0. See Details full list available options. DynamicHCR TRUE/FALSE. Whether use static dynamic reference points (default = FALSE). Ftarget Target fishing mortality rate (yr^-1) (SPR depletion based) input F projections. example, Ftarget spr F40%, enter 0.40. Flimit Limit fishing mortality rate (yr^-1) (SPR depletion based). example, Flimit spr F35%, enter 0.35. Ptarget Target spawning-stock biomass percentage static dynamic spawning-stock-biomass F = 0 (accounts recruitment). Plimit Limit spawning-stock biomass percentage static dynamic spawning-stock-biomass F = 0 (accounts recruitment). Alpha Parameter used NPFMC Tier 3 HCR. Pstar Quantile used uncertainty buffer given Flimit Sigma. Sigma Standard deviation used normally distributed uncertainty buffer given Flimit Pstar. Fmult Multiplier target F (default = 1). Used scale target fishing mortality following NEFSC convention. HCRorder multi-species models, order project fishing (e.g., predators first, prey).

title: Specify the harvest control rule (HCR) used for Rceattle — build_hcr
text: list containing harvest control rule associated biological reference points.

title: Specify the harvest control rule (HCR) used for Rceattle — build_hcr
text: Harvest control rule formulations currently implemented Rceattle: hcr = 0 "NoFishing": catch. Estimate hindcast. hcr = 1 "CMSY": CMSY. Maximize catch across species simultaneously. CMSY can constrained depletion fall Plimit. hcr = 2 "ConstantF": Constant input F set Ftarget species (vector single F). SPR (single-species ) based Flimit specified via Flimit. hcr = 3 "ConstantFSSB": F achieves Ftarget% SSB0 end projection. hcr = 4 "ConstantFSPR": Constant Fspr set Ftarget species. Can multiplied Fmult following NEFSC. hcr = 5 "NPFMC": North Pacific Fishery Management Council (NPFMC) Tier 3 spawner-per-recruit-based harvest control rule: Stock status: \(SB > SB Ftarget\) $$Fofl = Flimit$$ $$Fuse = Ftarget$$ Stock status: \(Alpha < SB / SB Ftarget \le 1\) $$Fofl = Flimit * (SB / Ptarget - Alpha) / (1 - Alpha)$$ $$Fuse = Ftarget * (SB / Ptarget - Alpha) / (1 - Alpha)$$ Stock status: \(SB / SB Ftarget \le Alpha\) \(SB < Plimit * SB0\) $$Fofl = 0$$ $$Fuse = 0$$ hcr = 6 "PFMC": HCR based Pacific Fishery Management Council (PFMC) category 1 40-10 annual catch limit (ABC) harvest control rule assuming Fofl normally distributed standard deviation (sigma) = 0.5 uncertainty quantile buffer (P*) 0.45 (PFMC 2020). model uses Fspr single-species F achieves X% SSB0 multi-species. Target biological reference points calculated based normal cumulative distribution function (Phi(quantile,mean,standard deviation)), P*, sigma follows: Stock status: \(SB > SB0 * Ptarget\) $$Fofl = Flimit$$ $$Fuse = Phi(Pstar, Flimit, Sigma)$$ Stock status: \(SB0 * Plimit < SB \le SB0 * Ptarget\) $$Fofl = Flimit$$ $$Fuse = Phi(Pstar, Flimit, Sigma) * \frac{SB0 * Ptarget * (SB - SB0 * Plimit)}{SB * SB0 * (Ptarget - Plimit)}$$ Stock status: \(SB < SB0 * Plimit\) $$Fofl = 0$$ $$Fuse = 0$$ hcr = 7 "SESSF": HCR based Southern Eastern Scalefish Shark Fishery (SESSF) spawner-per-recruit-based Tier 1 harvest control rule F_Limit=F_(20%), B_Limit=SB_20, F_Target (AFMA 2017) calculated follows: Stock status: \(SB > SB0 * Ptarget\) $$Fofl = Flimit$$ $$Fuse = Ftarget$$ Stock status: \(Ptarget > SB > SB0 * Plimit\) $$Fofl = Flimit * (SB / (SB0 * Ptarget) - 1)$$ $$Fuse = Ftarget * (SB / (SB0 * Ptarget) - 1)$$ Stock status: \(SB < SB0 * Plimit\) $$Fofl = 0$$ $$Fuse = 0$$ NOTE: HCRs 1, 2, 3, 6 work multi-species mode.

text: Maps base selectivity parameters (log_sel_slp, sel_inf, sel_coff) time-varying deviations, based Selectivity Time_varying_sel settings fleet_control. Selectivity fleet_control data determines shape selectivity curve: 0 = "Fixed" empirical selectivity provided emp_sel data 1 = "Logistic" 2 = "NonParametric" selecitivty sensu Ianelli et al 2018 3 = "DoubleLogistic" 4 = "DescendingLogistic" 5 = "Hake" non-parametric selectivity sensu Taylor et al 2014 (Hake) 6 = "2DAR1" across age x year 7 = "3DAR1" across age x cohort x year (Cheng et al 2024) 8 = "DoubleNormal" Gaussian ascending/descending limbs blended peak (analogous SS3 pattern 24). Parameters: sel_inf[1] = peak; sel_inf[2] = logit(right_floor) (right-tail floor, SS3 P6/end_logit); log_sel_slp[1] = log(sigma_asc); log_sel_slp[2] = log(sigma_desc). right_floor→0: dome-shaped; right_floor→1: logistic ascending . N_sel_bins	Number age/length bins estimate non-parametric selectivity Selectivity = 2 5. used otherwise Time_varying_sel	determines time-varying selectivity estimated logistic, double logistic selectivity,  descending logistic , non-parametric, hake (Selectivity = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5). 0 = 'None' 1 = 'IID' penalized deviates given sel_sd_prior 3 = 'Block' time blocks penalty 4 = 'RandomWalk' random walk following Dorn 5 = 'RandomWalkAscending' random walk ascending portion double logistic . random_sel fit_mod treats random deviates random walk parameters random effects, estimating variance.

OSA residuals require every observation enters likelihood live single flat vector (obsvec) companion keep indicator. function walks already-built control/observation matrices produces: obsvec – flat vector observations. R-side metadata ; removed data list passed TMB. *_obsvec_idx – per observation-row index vectors. aggregate series 0-based obsvec position row; composition caal 0-based obsvec position row's FIRST bin (template reads row's bins obsvec.segment(start, n_bins)). -1 marks rows excluded likelihood. inclusion rules per-row bin counts must match guards TMB template exactly, every observation template evaluates valid obsvec position. fitted observation types handled: aggregate catch index, comp caal composition, predator diet composition.

what: Specify the stock-recruit relationship (SRR) for Rceattle — build_srr
title: Specify the stock-recruit relationship (SRR) for Rceattle — build_srr
text: Stock recruitment relationships currently implemented Rceattle: srr_fun = 0 "mean": stock recruit relationship. Recruitment function R0 annual deviates (.e. steepness = 0.99). $$R_y = exp(R0 + R_{dev,y})$$ srr_fun = 2 "BevertonHolt": Beverton-holt stock-recruitment relationship $$R_y = \frac{\alpha_{srr} * SB_{y-minage}}{1+\beta_{srr} * SB_{y-minage}}$$ srr_fun = 4 "Ricker": Ricker stock-recruitment relationship $$R_y = \alpha_{srr} * SB_{y-minage} * exp(-\beta_{srr} * SB_{y-minage})$$ srr_pred_fun > 0 srr_fun = 0 recruitment hindcast estimated srr_fun = 0 $$R_y = exp(R0 + R_{dev,y})$$, additional stock recruitment relationship defined srr_pred_fun estimated srr_hat_styr srr_hat_endyr treated additional penalty. stock recruitment relationship defined srr_pred_fun used projection.

title: Specify the stock-recruit relationship (SRR) for Rceattle — build_srr
text: srr_fun Stock recruit function used hindcast estimation Rceattle (see @description ). Default = 0 srr_pred_fun stock recruit function projection, reference points, penalties used Rceattle (see ). srr_fun == 0, treats stock-recruit curve additional penalty onto annualy estimated recruitment hindcast (sensu AMAK Jim Ianelli's pollock model). srr_fun > 0 srr_pred_fun = srr_fun additional penalty included. proj_mean_rec Project model using: 0 = mean recruitment (average R hindcast) 1 = SRR(omega, srr_devs) srr_mse_switchyr used MSEs deal AMAK Jim Ianelli's estimation stock recruit function estimated additional penalty  (srr_fun = 0 srr_pred_fun > 0). tells model year switch stock recruit function. srr_hat_styr Integer. first year used estimating recruitment function additional penalty. add additional penalties sensu AMAK Jim Ianelli's pollock model srr_pred_fun > 0 srr_fun = 0, starting styr + 1. Defaults $styr + 1$ $data_list$. Useful environmental data used condition stock-recruit relationships available end-year, projections desired. srr_hat_endyr Integer. last year used estimating recruitment function additional penalty. add additional penalties sensu AMAK Jim Ianelli's pollock model srr_pred_fun > 0 srr_fun = 0. Recruitment Defaults $endyr$ $data_list$. Useful environmental data used condition stock-recruit relationships available full time-series, projections desired. srr_est_mode Switch determine estimation mode. 0 = fix alpha prior mean, 1 = freely estimate R0, alpha, /beta (default), 2 = use lognormally distributed prior alpha (Ricker) steepness (Beverton), 3 = use beta distributed prior steepness (Beverton) given mean sd. srr_prior mean normally distributed prior stock-recruit parameter srr_prior_sd Prior standard deviation stock-recruit parameter srr_indices Soft-deprecated. Use linkages argument instead. See vignette("environmental-linkages--priors"). Bmsy_lim Upper limit Ricker based SSB-MSY (e.g 1/Beta). add likelihood penalty beta estimated limit. Default NA used. linkages Optional named list linkage_spec() objects keyed recruitment parameter name (must one "R0", "alpha", "beta"). spec describes parameter depends environmental covariates stratifying factors (species, sex). offset enters additively (log scale) inside recruitment compute. See vignette("environmental-linkages--priors") details.

title: Bundle the optimizer / sdreport / phasing controls for fit_mod() — fit_control
text: bias.correct logical. TRUE, applies bias correction via TMB::sdreport(). Default FALSE. getsd logical. TRUE, run TMB::sdreport() optimization. Default TRUE. getJointPrecision logical. Return full Hessian fixed random effects. Default TRUE (matches fit_mod() default). getReportCovariance logical. Return variance-covariance ADREPORT variables. Default FALSE. projection_uncertainty logical. TRUE, accounts hindcast parameter uncertainty projections using HCR (refits hindcast biological-reference-point parameters turned ). Default FALSE speed. comp_offset Numeric NULL. Small proportion offset added observed predicted age/length composition conditional-age--length (caal) bins multinomial / Dirichlet-multinomial likelihood (avoid log(0) empty bins). Stored data_list fitted likelihood OSA observation vector use offset, internal re-fits inherit . NULL (default) inherits data_list$comp_offset set, otherwise 1e-5; number overrides . apply diet (stomach-content) compositions. bias_adjust_obs logical default TRUE. Whether apply bias adjustment (mean-sd^2/2) lognormal data likelihoods bias_adjust_proc logical default TRUE. Whether apply bias adjustment (mean-sd^2/2) lognormal process likelihoods use_gradient logical. Use analytic gradient phasing. Default TRUE. rel_tol Numeric tolerance used flag discontinuous likelihood warnings (compares TMB nlminb objectives). Default 1. loopnum Integer. Number times re-start optimization (loopnum = 3 sometimes achieves lower final gradient loopnum = 1). Default 5. newtonsteps Integer. Number extra Newton steps take optimization (alternative loopnum). Default 0. phase TRUE/FALSE list. FALSE, model phased. TRUE, default phasing used. Can also accept list parameter object names corresponding phase. Default FALSE. TMBfilename Optional character. Path (without .cpp) alternate TMB template development. Default NULL (use bundled ceattle_v01_11). verbose 0 = silent, 1 = print updates model fit, 2 = print updates model fit TMB estimation progress. Default 1. nlminb_control list control parameters passed stats::nlminb(). See ?nlminb. Default list(eval.max = 1e9, iter.max = 1e9, trace = 0).

text: data_list data list read via read_data built directly R; see vignette("data-without-excel", package = "Rceattle"). inits (Optional) named list initial parameter values, returned build_params extracted previous fit (model$estimated_params). NULL, parameters initialized scratch via build_params. map (Optional) map object build_map. bounds (Optional) bounds object build_bounds. file (Optional) Filename files saved. NULL, file saved. estimateMode 0 = Fit hindcast model projection HCR specified via HCR. 1 = Fit hindcast model (projection). 2 = Run projection HCR specified via HCR given initial parameters inits. 3 = build : runs model MakeADFun nlminb. returned obj carries real objective gradient, obj$fn() / obj$gr() usable diagnosing model committing fit. 4 = runs model MakeADFun nlminb parameters mapped ; plumbing smoke test objective placeholder (dummy^2), likelihood. random_rec logical. TRUE, treats recruitment deviations random effects using laplace approximation.default FALSE. random_q logical. TRUE, treats annual catchability deviations random effects using laplace approximation.default FALSE. random_sel logical. TRUE, treats annual selectivity deviations random effects using laplace approximation.default FALSE. HCR HCR list object build_hcr niter Number iterations multispecies model recFun stock recruit-relationship parameterization build_srr. M1Fun M1 parameterizations priors. Use build_M1. growthFun weight--age parameterization build_growth. msmMode predation mortality functions used. Defaults predation mortality used. avgnMode average abundance--age approximation used predation mortality equations. 0 (default) \(N/Z ( 1 - exp(-Z) )\), 1 \(N exp(-Z/2)\), 2 \(N\). initMode population initialized. 0 = initial age-structure estimated free parameters; 1 = equilibrium age-structure estimated R0 + mortality (M1); 2 = non-equilibrium age-structure estimated R0,  mortality (M1), initial population deviates; 3 = non-equilibrium age-structure estimated initial fishing mortality (Finit), R0,  mortality (M1), initial population deviates; 4 = non-equilibrium age-structure version 2 initial fishing mortality (Finit) scales R0. suitMode Switch suitability derivation predator (single value vector). 0 = empirical based diet data (Holsman et al. 2015), 1 = length-based gamma suitability, 2 = weight-based gamma suitability, 3 = length-based lognormal suitability, 4 = weight-based lognormal suitability, 5 = length-based normal suitability, 6 = weight-based normal suitability. suit_styr Integer. first year used calculate mean suitability. Defaults $styr$ $data_list$. Used diet data sampled subset years. suit_endyr Integer. last year used calculate mean suitability. Defaults $endyr$ $data_list$. title: Capture a linkage specification — linkage_spec
text: formula one-sided R formula whose RHS describes linear predictor param (e.g. ~ 1, ~ temp, ~ temp + PDO). param target parameter name natural scale (e.g. "alpha", "M1", "K"). May NULL spec built inside build_*() call infers parameter name enclosing list key (see build_growth()). data (Optional) data frame formula validation. Currently validation happens materialization time inside fit_mod(). one-sided formula naming stratifying factors get coefficients. Allowed names species, sex, age_bin. default ~species produces one coefficient set per species (typical multispecies assessment use case); pass ~species + sex per-(species, sex) coefficients, NULL share single coefficient set across every species/sex. species optional integer vector 1-based species ids spec applies . NULL (default) means every species strata$species materialization time. Use give different species different formulas, e.g. registering multiple specs parameter – see build_growth() multi-spec syntax. sex optional vector sex ids spec applies . May supplied integers (1L = female, 2L = male) character strings ("Females"/"Males", case-insensitive; "female", "male", "f", "m" also accepted). NULL (default) means every sex strata$sex materialization time. meaningful includes sex; otherwise filter -op. Use register separate specs per sex (e.g. one prior females, another males) parameter. link link function relating linear predictor natural-scale target parameter. One "log" (default) "identity". link = "log", log(param) = X * beta – slope contributions multiplicative natural-scale parameter. link = "identity", param = X * beta – slope contributions additive natural scale. linkage targets currently expose log-scale TMB parameters, "log" natural default; "identity" reserved future processes (e.g. logit steepness). init optional named numeric vector initial values keyed design-matrix column name (e.g. c((Intercept) = 4, temp = 0)). Missing entries default 0. bounds optional named list c(lower, upper) keyed way init. priors optional named list whose entries Rceattle_priors objects, keyed design-matrix column name. Inside argument unprefixed shorthand normal(), lognormal(), gamma(), beta() resolves corresponding prior_* constructors via private data mask, priors = list(temp = normal(0, 1)) works without masking base::gamma() base::beta() package level. Equivalent priors = list(temp = prior_normal(0, 1)). re_group optional character: name random-effect grouping coefficients. NA (default) means fixed. est_phase optional integer estimation phase. Default 1L.

what: One-step-ahead (OSA) residuals for an Rceattle model — osa_residuals
title: One-step-ahead (OSA) residuals for an Rceattle model — osa_residuals
text: Computes one-step-ahead (OSA) residuals – also called forecast quantile residuals (Thygesen et al. 2017) – fitted Rceattle model via TMB::oneStepPredict(). Unlike Pearson residuals, OSA residuals distributed iid standard normal correctly specified model even observations correlated (composition bins) model contains random effects, support objective goodness--fit testing (Trijoulet et al. 2023; Stewart Monnahan 2025). internal OSA residuals: residualization integrated assessment via TMB, also accounts correlation induced model's random effects across years – gold standard relative external compResidual approach (Stewart Monnahan 2025). OSA residuals computed post hoc expensive (TMB re-optimizes random effects observation added), produced fit_mod(). model must optimized estimateMode < 3. Supported observation types aggregate "catch" "index" series, "comp" (age/length composition) "caal" (conditional age--length) compositions, "diet" (predator stomach-content composition, multispecies models estimated suitability). Diet opt-(default types) applies multispecies models can expensive. composition data multivariate multinomial / Dirichlet-multinomial decomposed sequence univariate conditional residuals (binomial / beta-binomial; Trijoulet et al. 2023). final bin composition fixed sum--N constraint residual (returned NA). Composition OSA uses internal model rebuild unweighted, proper densities (osa_mode switch); fleets fit AFSC MultinomialAFSC pseudo-likelihood residualized full multinomial.

title: One-step-ahead (OSA) residuals for an Rceattle model — osa_residuals
text: fit fitted object class Rceattle (fit_mod()). source Character vector observation sources residualize: "index", "catch", "comp", "caal", "diet", "". Defaults four non-diet sources (diet opt-applies multispecies models can expensive); pass "" include diet. Sources observations model silently skipped. Mirrors source argument residuals.Rceattle() plot.rceattle_osa(). method Passed TMB::oneStepPredict(). Defaults "oneStepGaussianOffMode" (WHAM/SAM default), appropriate lognormal aggregate series. discrete Logical; whether treat composition (comp / caal / diet) observations discrete. Default FALSE (continuous, matching CEATTLE fits composition likelihood effective-sample-size-scaled counts). TRUE, composition residuals randomized quantile residuals (Dunn Smyth 1996) stochastic; set seed reproducibility. aggregate index/catch series always continuous (lognormal); TMB::oneStepPredict() call split observation type discrete applied correctly per type (discrete group uses generic CDF-based method rather method). parallel Logical; compute per-observation OSA loop parallel via parallel::mclapply(). Default TRUE. main speedup models random effects, observation triggers Laplace re-evaluation – gives near-linear speedup across cores (set options(mc.cores = ) choose many; forking falls back serial Windows). continuous group parallelized; discrete (randomized-quantile) path always runs serially stays reproducible given seed. seed Random seed passed TMB::oneStepPredict() reproducibility randomized-quantile residuals. Default 123. trace Logical; print TMB::oneStepPredict() progress. Default FALSE. ... arguments passed TMB::oneStepPredict().

what: Process residuals for an Rceattle model's random-effect processes — process_residuals
title: Process residuals for an Rceattle model's random-effect processes — process_residuals
text: One-sample process residuals model's random-effect (penalized) process deviations, style SAM's procres() (Nielsen Berg 2014). validate process model – whether deviations behave like assumed iid normal process – complement observation-based osa_residuals(). set deviations carries Gaussian process prior model. posterior mode deviations shrunk toward prior, – following SAM – single draw taken joint posterior deviations (joint precision random effects, fixed-effect covariance penalized fixed effects) standardized process standard deviation. correctly specified process approximately iid N(0, 1). random draw used residuals stochastic; set seed reproducibility. Supported processes deviations: "recruitment" rec_dev, prior N(-bias_adjust_proc * R_sd^2/2, R_sd^2) per species. "initial" init_dev, prior N(-bias_adjust_proc * R_sd^2/2, R_sd^2) per species. "catchability" index_q_dev, prior N(0, q_dev_sd^2) per index. "" returns every supported process present fit. Selectivity natural-mortality deviations (use random-walk / 2D-AR1 priors) yet supported. Recruitment initial-abundance residuals exact (priors iid). Catchability residuals exact iid deviate prior (Time_varying_q = 1 2); random-walk AR1 catchability prior marginal-SD standardization ignores prior correlation, residuals approximate warning emitted.

title: Likelihood profile across one or more parameter cells — profile.Rceattle
text: fitted Rceattle model fit using fit_mod param Name parameter profile. Two ways specify : Raw parameter slot name Rceattle$estimated_params; tested "R_log_sd", "rec_pars", "log_M1". slots must index full array transform controls scale. Natural-scale alias convenience shortcut three documented parameters. Aliases imply transform = "log" (values taken natural units log'd substituted) , rec_pars, fill column alias name slots needs species index: "sigmaR", "R_sd" -> R_log_sd "M1" -> log_M1 "R0" -> rec_pars[, 1] "alpha" -> rec_pars[, 2] "beta" -> rec_pars[, 3] transform supplied alias ignored (warning). slots list whose entries integer index vectors, one entry per cell fix. entry's length must equal number dimensions resolved parameter – 1 vectors (R_log_sd), 2 matrices (rec_pars), 3 3-D arrays (log_M1). using "R0"/"alpha"/"beta" aliases, supply species index (length 1); column filled alias. E.g. list(c(1, 2, 1)) fixes log_M1[1, 2, 1]; list(c(1, 1, 1), c(1, 2, 1)) fixes sex cells males-vs-females cross-profile species 1; list(1, 2) param = "sigmaR" cross-profiles species 1 2. omitted, defaults single species-1 slot shaped match resolved parameter (e.g. list(1) R_log_sd, list(c(1, 1, 1)) log_M1, list(1) rec_pars aliases) emits warning; pass slots explicitly silence warning. Defaulting requires length(values) == 1L (otherwise user must explicitly say cell grid targets). values list numeric vectors, one per entry slots. full grid fits expand.grid(values), single slot gives 1-D profile k slots give k-D cross-profile. transform map user values onto internal parameter scale substituting inits. Either "log" (default), "identity", unary function (e.g. qlogis). Applied element-wise every grid value. Aliases override "log". cores Number cores use parallel fits. Default NULL picks parallel::detectCores() - 6, capped 2 running R CMD check (sets _R_CHECK_LIMIT_CORES_). Set 1 force sequential execution. ... Unused; present consistency stats::profile generic.

title: Residuals from an Rceattle fit — residuals.Rceattle
text: Residual kinds (type): "response" Observed minus fitted. index / catch log scale default (matching lognormal likelihood; set scale = "natural" arithmetic difference); comp / caal difference proportions, observed minus fitted. "pearson" Standardized residuals. index / catch, \((\log o - (\log\hat{o} - b\,\sigma^2/2))/\sigma\) using model's realized observation log-SD \(\sigma\) observation bias-adjustment flag \(b\) (bias_adjust_obs, default 1); comp / caal, \((p - \hat{p})/\sqrt{\hat{p}(1 - \hat{p})/N}\) input sample size N. "osa" One-step-ahead residuals via osa_residuals(), builds composition observation data demand fit. "process" Process residuals via process_residuals() model's random-effect deviations; source apply. Composition rows returned long form (one row per observation x age/length bin) carry Age0_Length1 flag comp_data (0 age, 1 length); CAAL rows carry conditioning Length age Bin.

Natural-scale inits: Standardized init evaluation initial values "(Intercept)" parameters applied natural scale. Linkage link functions: Fully implemented dual-path linkage offsets. link = "log" (new default) applies offset multiplicatively natural scale (additive log scale); link = "identity" applies additively natural scale. Runs parallel default (PSOCK cluster, capped 2 cores R CMD check) per-simulation seed + results reproducible sequential parallel execution. Supports arbitrary N-D cross-profiles via expand.grid() list per-cell value grids (e.g. cross-profiling log_M1 across sex, R_log_sd across multiple species). Natural-scale aliases "sigmaR" / "R_sd", "M1", "R0" / "alpha" / "beta" apply implicit log() transform (rec_pars aliases) auto-fill column, slots needs species index. slots defaults species 1 warning. text: SRR logic: Fixed bug build_srr() Bmsy_lim penalty incorrectly disabled current Ricker implementations due index mismatch. Also corrected length--age minage = 0 closed-form anchor L1 honored within-year cohort recursion paths. Length-bin midpoint weight--age: calculate_weight() now computes bin’s midpoint (lengths[ln] + lengths[ln+1]) / 2 (plus-group extended half final interior width) rather lengths[ln] + (lengths[1] - lengths[0]) / 2. previous formula assumed uniform bin widths silently mis-located midpoint non-uniform length bins; uniform bins (common case) two algebraically identical, existing fits unchanged. Plus-group SD--age pinned upper anchor: growth builders growth.hpp now pin oldest age class’s length_sd exp(growth_log_sd(sp, sex, 1)) (SD Linf), matching WHAM (SDAA plus group = SD_len(1)), instead length-based interpolation SD(L1) SD(Linf) used previously. makes plus-group convention consistent across von Bertalanffy Richards growth across builders; expect small numerical change length_sd oldest age relative prior versions. fit_mod() bounds ordering: fit_mod() now indexes parameter bounds name rather positional order assembling L / U nlminb. Previously, map$mapFactor bounds$lower identical order, parameters paired another parameter’s bounds, producing silently wrong constraints. start_par now also subset name drop = FALSE. mse_summary() Tier-3 Flimit: internal flimit_tier3_fun() returned Flimit (argument) instead depletion-adjusted tier3_flimit just computed, Tier-3 (HCR = 5) branch P(F > Flimit) reduced base-Flimit check. Selectivity block indexing: Renamed within-loop biom_yrs index vector block_yrs selectivity catchability block branches build_map_*(). previous name leftover index-data path shadowed nothing, read referred biomass-observation years. plot_index() / plot_catch() / plot_logindex() warnings: Wrapped internal gplots::plotCI() calls suppressWarnings() plotting fit longer prints recurring "arrows(...): zero-length arrow indeterminate angle skipped" noise CI half-widths zero.

what: Environmental linkages: a unified, formula-driven API
title: Rceattle 4.1.0
text: new long-format linkage table lets users express process parameters depend environmental covariates stratifying factors (species, sex, age) single formula-driven helper, linkage_spec(). row table corresponds exactly one estimated coefficient. fit_mod() pools every spec shared design matrix X per-row parameter vector beta_linkage; TMB template iterates table accumulates per-process offsets linear predictor underlying parameter. New constructor: linkage_spec(). Captures (formula, , species, link, init, bounds, priors, est_phase) one process parameter. Anything model.matrix() understands works: ~ 1, ~ temp + PDO, ~ poly(temp, 4), ~ (temp^2), ~ splines::ns(temp, df = 4), ~ temp * PDO, etc. Per-species formulas. Register multiple specs parameter via linkages = list(log_K = list(spec_a, spec_b)) spec’s optional species = ... argument scoping subset stocks. pooler unions design columns across specs ’s duplication species share covariates. Priors. First-class via prior_normal(), prior_lognormal(), prior_gamma(), prior_beta(). constructors available unprefixed (normal() / lognormal() / …) inside priors = ... argument via private NSE data mask, user code stays close mathematical notation without masking base::gamma() / base::beta() package level. Priors can single value applied every species, named list keyed species id (shortly, (species, sex)). Bounds. Per-row lower / upper flow build_bounds()$lower$beta_linkage / build_bounds()$upper$beta_linkage. Growth (von Bertalanffy / Richards) first process fully wired new pipeline. build_growth() gains linkages argument string-named fun ("empirical" / "vonBertalanffy" / "Richards"); integer codes still work (fun = 1 shorthand fun = "vonBertalanffy") existing scripts don’t need rewritten apart substituting fun = growth_model =. TMB plumbing. New src/TMB/linkage.hpp accumulator; ceattle_v01_11.cpp reads parallel DATA_IVECTOR(linkage_*) inputs plus DATA_MATRIX(linkage_X) writes growth_linkage_offset tensor added (additively, log scale) growth_parameters. Per-row prior densities contribute slot 19 joint NLL (“Linkage-table priors” fit$quantities$jnll_comp). Documentation. New vignette vignette("environmental-linkages", package = "Rceattle") walks API, prior families, species-keyed priors, per-species formulas, basis-expansion formulas, underlying pipeline. Natural mortality second process wired pipeline. build_M1() gains linkages argument keyed log_M1; offset added log scale log_M1 inside M1_at_age compute. row’s age_bin == NA broadcasts offset across ages; specific values pin age slice. build_M1() also gains string-form acceptance M1_model M1_re (parity build_growth(fun)): Growth M can linked fit; rows share global linkage table beta_linkage parameter vector. Per-(species, sex) priors. addition scalar species-keyed priors, priors[[col]] value may two-level nested list keyed first species id sex id: Missing keys either level resolve “prior” stratum. validator checks structure recursively emits actionable error messages keyed priors$<col>$<species>[$<sex>] paths. Default = ~ species. linkage_spec() now defaults argument ~ species, linkage produces one coefficient per species without user spell . Pass ~ species + sex per-(species, sex) coefficients, = NULL share single coefficient across every species/sex (prior default). matches typical multispecies assessment use case stock environmental sensitivity. Recruitment third process wired pipeline. build_srr() gains linkages argument keyed log_R0, log_alpha, log_beta; offset added log scale corresponding parameter every recruitment compute call site (hindcast, BRPs, projections, expected R). log_R0 meaningful srr_fun; log_alpha log_beta work SRRs consume (srr_fun c(2, 3, 4, 5) – Beverton-Holt Ricker). Growth, M, recruitment can linked fit; rows share global linkage table beta_linkage parameter vector. End--end tests tests/testthat/tests-Dynamics/test-linkage-auto-map.R verify base parameter (e.g., log_growth_pars, log_M1, rec_pars) automatically mapped (set NA) linkage active parameter, allowing linkage intercept define base value. tests/testthat/tests-Dynamics/test-recruitment-linkage.R cover analytical relations R = R0 * exp(beta * temp[yr]) (mean R) growth + M + recruitment composition. Soft deprecation build_M1(). legacy column-index argument M1_indices env-driven structural integer codes M1_model %% c(4, 5) subsumed new linkages = list(log_M1 = ...) argument. still work one release cycle, emit one-time warning points users equivalent linkage-table call. string aliases "env_sex_invariant" / "env_sex_specific" (added briefly dev branch) removed; never released. cpp’s M1_beta / M1_mult code path stays place now – paths add additively log_M1 log scale – use coefficient double-count. Roadmap. Recruitment next pipeline; random-effects pooling re_group hierarchical shrinkage. legacy M1_indices / M1_model = 4|5 paths retire recruitment migrates.

title: Rceattle 4.0.1
text: build_M1: M1_prior_mean -> M_prior, M1_prior_sd -> M_prior_sd. build_srr: srr_prior_mean -> srr_prior; R_hat_endyr replaced srr_hat_styr / srr_hat_endyr. fit_mod: suit_meanyr replaced suit_styr / suit_endyr. initMode semantics revised: 0 = free-parameter N--age, 1 = unfished equilibrium devs, 2 (default) = unfished equilibrium initial devs, 3 = fished equilibrium initial devs. Type 4 (“non-equilibrium scaled”) added later.

what: New features – composition and diet likelihoods
title: Rceattle 4.0.1
text: Dirichlet-multinomial composition likelihood. Selected per fleet via fleet_control$Comp_loglike = 1 ("DirichletMultinomial"). Conditional age--length (CAAL) data path, CAAL_loglike / CAAL_weights controls fleet_control. CAAL data also flow sim_mod() simulation testing. Diet_loglike switch bioenergetics control sheet selects multinomial (0) Dirichlet-multinomial (1) diet composition. -food diet proportion estimates added model report. Weighted-mean diet data path (annual proportion prey--age predator--age averaged across years).

title: Rceattle 4.0.1
text: Hake non-parametric selectivity (Selectivity = "Hake" 5), Taylor et al. 2DAR1 (= 6) 3DAR1 (= 7) selectivity parameterizations, Cheng et al. (2024). Catchability = 6 (“AR1”): annual AR1 catchability deviates fit environmental index, Rogers et al. (2024) GOA pollock model. Environmental q-link (Catchability = 5) also exposed. Internal growth model. See build_growth() growthFun argument fit_mod(). alpha_wt_len / beta_wt_len added data control sheet. Length-based suitability (suitMode = 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6) wired use estimated growth model. Comparison WHAM growth implemented tests/comparison/. Predator-specific suitability mode (different suitMode per predator). Suitability calculation now uses configurable year ranges (suit_styr / suit_endyr) instead “mean year”.

what: New features – recruitment and reference points
title: Rceattle 4.0.1
text: Beta-distributed prior Beverton-Holt steepness, available via srr_est_mode = 3. M1 random effects optional environmental linkage; M_prior / M_prior_sd priors carried build_M1(). remove_F() function returns fitted model F set 0 – used internally dynamic reference point calculation. DynamicHCR = TRUE build_hcr() switch static dynamic SB0 reference points. CMSY harvest control rule (HCR = 1): maximize joint catch across species, optionally constrained keep depletion Plimit. PFMC Category 1 40-10 ABC HCR (HCR = 6) using Pstar / Sigma uncertainty buffer. SESSF Tier 1 HCR (HCR = 7). Iterative multi-species HCRs: HCRorder controls order species F solved (e.g. predators prey) inside build_hcr().

title: Rceattle 4.0.1
text: run_mse() now writes per-simulation .rds files dir specified, streaming-friendly long runs. load_mse() reads back. check_mse() validates OM/EM simulations converged. mse_summary() produces per-fleet performance-metric table (mean catch, IAV, P(closed), MSE SSB, P(F > Flimit), P(SSB < SSBlimit), terminal depletion, …). MSE function now supports cap (catch cap), catch_mult (catch multiplier), rec_trend (linear projected recruitment trend), fut_sample (future sampling effort), per-fleet assessment_period / sampling_period, regenerate_past (refit EM OM-simulated past data), timeout/try-error handling per simulation. Recruitment_and_fixed_F_projections.R Simulation_testing.R examples added.

title: Rceattle 4.0.1
text: jitter() function perturb starting values re-fit, global-vs-local-minimum diagnostics. retrospective() peels optional nyrs_forecast. model_average() averaging derived quantities across multiple fitted models, optional bootstrap uncertainty. compare_sim() sim_mod() parametric simulation testing. McAllister-Ianelli-reweighting.R example composition reweighting. TMB log-likelihood pieces (unweighted) added report composition diagnostics. Selectivity = "Fixed" (= 0) empirically supplied selectivity blocks via emp_sel data sheet. TMBfilename argument fit_mod() point alternate .cpp development.

title: Rceattle 4.0.1
text: Removed accumulation-age switches fleet_control. Selectivity normalization now controlled via Age_max_selected (.e. Sel_norm_bin1) per-fleet basis instead always normalizing maximum-selectivity age. NA values inside valid age/length range composition data now coerced 0 warning (previously silently dropped errored). Selectivity dimensioning switched age- bin-indexed non-parametric 2D/3D AR1 forms (driven Selectivity_dimension N_sel_bins). Age-error age-transition matrices now dimension-checked nages data_check() time.

title: Rceattle 4.0.0
text: CEATTLE TMB version 4.0.0. See Adams et al. (2022), Fisheries Research, 251, 106303.
